senses.en_definition: To tell someone something; to give someone information or news.

collocations.en: tell the truth about what happened

messages.en: Does Ms Lina know the meeting's been moved to three?
I told her earlier, but she probably hasn't read the message yet.
Okay, I'll give her a quick call in a bit to make sure.
I'm cleaning the kitchen. Have you wiped the table yet?
Yep, the table's clean. I've just got to take out the rubbish now.
Your little one's growing up so fast—almost ready to start school!
I know, it feels like he only just learned to walk.

senses.en_definition: To leave someone or something as they are, without taking action or giving them attention.
To allow someone to do something without stopping or forbidding them.

messages.en: Don't leave the door open, or Oyen will get out. He's already waiting there.
Okay, Mum. I'm carrying some things in. I'll shut it as soon as I'm done.
